title: 'Enable See Financial Data?' dialog — Cancel: undoes the tick
custom_preconds:
1. See Financial Data is OFF and Part sales View, Create & Edit and Delete are unticked.
  2. Tick Part sales View so the dialog opens.
custom_steps:
1. Click Cancel.
  2. Look at the Part sales View box and the See Financial Data toggle.
custom_expected:
The dialog closes.

Part sales View is unticked again.

See Financial Data stays OFF.
evidence: UI: Cancel on the SFD dialog undoes the tick (See Financial Data off, Part sales off).
